defs.def: （常用于表示轻微的批评、失望或惊讶）相当，在某种程度上

ex.s: For native speakers of English, some Chinese words are rather difficult to pronounce.
ex.t: 对英语母语者来说，一些中文字词相当难发音。

ex.s: It also provides a rather strong foundation for empathy across cultures.
ex.t: 它还为不同文化之间的同情提供了相当坚实的基础。

ex.s: Here are some of our favourites, to remind us that some of the English we learn in the classroom is rather different from the English in the outside world!
ex.t: 以下是我们最喜欢的几个例子，它们提醒我们，我们在课堂上学的一些英语和外面世界里的英语相当不一样！

ex.s: We could also say It happens rather often that people make very bad films based upon very good books.

ex.s: People are also discovering the fun of interacting with the celebrations, rather than simply watching as part of an audience.
ex.t: 人们也在发现与庆典互动的乐趣，而不仅仅是作为观众观看。

defs.def: （与动词连用以减弱语气）有点儿，稍微
（纠正所说的话或提供更确切的信息）更确切地讲，更准确地说

ex.s: Rather than setting plans in stone, I’ve learned that sometimes I need to take the opportunities that are offered, even if they don’t sound perfect at the time, and make the most of them.
ex.t: 与其把计划定死，我学到了有时候我需要抓住提供的机会，即使当时听起来并不完美，并且充分利用它们。

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.s: She writes from the practical angle of a business person rather than as an academic, making for a guide which is highly accessible and informative and which, by the close, will make you feel almost as smart as AI.
ex.t: 她从一个商人的实用角度而非学者角度写作，使这本指南极易读又有信息量，读到最后会让你觉得自己几乎和AI一样聪明。

defs.def: （提出不同或相反的观点）相反，反而，而是

ex.s: Rather than watering rows of soil, the system provides just the right amount to each plant.
ex.t: 系统不是浇灌一排排土壤，而是为每株植物提供恰到好处的水量。

ex.s: Importantly, however, the beauty group did not report feeling any happier than the control group, suggesting that it was the engagement with beauty that influenced abstract thinking, rather than any overall positivity from the experience.

ex.t: 这可以是创作中的作品，而不是已完成的最终稿。

ex.t: 他主张的是一种预防性原则，而非彻底的禁止。

ex.t: 最终，我弟弟决定离开，而不是强求。

ex.s: It’s thanks to these TV chefs rather than any advertising campaign that Britons are turning away from meat-and-two-veg and ready-made meals and becoming more adventurous in their cooking habits.

ex.t: 但它们通常有一些共同要素：故事不是干巴巴的事实罗列，而是有情节，并且会介绍人物。

ex.s: This research overturns the popular view that all human speech sounds were present when human beings evolved around 300,000 years ago. ”The set of speech sounds we use has not necessarily remained stable since the appearance of human beings, but rather the huge variety of speech sounds that we find today is the product of a complex interplay of things like biological change and cultural evolution,“ said Steven Moran, a member of the research team.
ex.t: 这项研究推翻了“人类约30万年前进化时所有语音都已存在”的流行观点。“我们使用的语音集合自人类出现以来未必保持稳定，我们今天发现的极其多样的语音，是生物变化和文化演变等事物复杂相互作用的产物，”研究团队成员史蒂文·莫兰说。

ex.t: 保持房间凉爽而不是温暖，以避免犯困。

ex.s: Recent research suggests that if an argument gets resolved，the emotional response tied to it is significantly reduced or almost completely erased．Thus，it may be worth bringing up issues with your friends， family members，or classmates rather than holding them back．
ex.t: 最近的研究表明，如果一场争论得到解决，与之相关的情绪反应会显著减少，或几乎完全消除。因此，与其压抑，不如与朋友、家人或同学把问题提出来，可能最终会有更好的结果。

ex.s: Instead, I agree with Oxford University philosopher Nick Bostrom, who believes that the heaviest risks from A GI do not come from a decision to turn against mankind but rather from a dogged pursuit of set objectives at the expense of everything else.
ex.t: 相反,我同意牛津大学哲学家尼克·博斯特罗姆的观点,他相信GI带来的最重风险并非来自对全人类的背叛,而是来自于以牺牲其他一切为代价,对既定目标的顽强追求。
